title: Yellowfin Peruvian Fish Rocoto Relleno
description: A winey and adventurous Peruvian dish featuring yellowfin fish, fish sauce, and beurre monte, served in a bento box as a rocoto relleno. This raw-friendly dish combines the bold flavors of Peru with the delicate taste of yellowfin fish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the tops off the rocoto peppers and remove the seeds and membranes.
In a blender or food processor, blend the fish sauce, beurre monte, onions, garlic, cilantro, lime juice, salt, and black pepper until smooth.
Stuff each rocoto pepper with the blended mixture and top with a piece of yellowfin fish.
Place the stuffed peppers in a bento box and bake for 12 minutes.
Remove the peppers from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the Yellowfin Peruvian Fish Rocoto Relleno hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Pair the dish with a side of steamed vegetables or a salad for a well-rounded meal.
